vat.note: per month of VAT period not submitted (a quarterly return = 3 months)

payroll.note: per month not submitted, up to 5 employees; +£5 per extra employee per month

cis.note: CIS returns as contractor, per month not submitted, up to 5 subcontractors; +£5 per extra subcontractor per month

confirmation_statement.note: Companies House fee included. £99 if nothing has changed; £150 with changes (officers, shareholders, share capital, registered office, SIC code, PSCs) – Eduard 9 Nov 2026

monthly.note: (year-end + confirmation statement + software if needed + £150 per director) ÷ months to the company's next year-end (at least 3), plus payroll / CIS / VAT per month

id_verification.note: Directors must have verified their identity with Companies House before the confirmation statement or annual accounts are filed. Verified: give the personal code. Not verified: £50 per director, processed by TACS (Eduard 9 Nov 2026).

mtd.note: Eduard 10 Nov 2026: guide plan Compliance £40/month (+£20 per extra business/property), Full MTD with VAT £79 if VAT registered, Essential £19 as alternative; catch-up as above; no one-off set-up or per-quarter prices shown.

catch_up.note: months since the MTD start date not yet covered (before the current month) × the monthly plan; 10% off up to 3 months, 15% off more than 3 months; the current month is the first Direct Debit (Eduard 10 Nov 2026)
